title: Light Smoky Irish Fish Pilaf
description: A silky, light take on traditional Irish cuisine, featuring smoky flavors and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: leeks
ingredients.notes: white and light green parts only

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped leeks and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and smoked paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add the jasmine rice and stir to combine with the leek mixture.
Add the chicken broth, smoked cod, sea salt, and black pepper to the pressure cooker.
Close the lid and set the valve to 'sealing'.
Cook for 6 minutes at high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes.
Stir in the fresh parsley and lemon juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
